scope: independent Fractal forecast vs PLC emulator; same 30 s PLC snapshot, full physical second per emulator step
note: Ordinal pairing is diagnostic, not proof of event identity if cycle counts differ. Same-time emulator readings are taken at nearest 1 s; hourly levels, main flow and pressures are TRUE values (not noisy PLC sensor snapshots). Starting at t=30 s, Fractal holds each profile entry for a full 3600 s while operational PLC switches at t=3600,7200,...: at the recorded hour ends the emulator has applied the NEXT entry for 30 s. This is an input-boundary mismatch, not time alignment validation. Fractal holds hourly distribution fixed. Fractal recirculation totals are accumulated across hours, no commands applied.
